text:
Alex: hey all — last-minute travel hiccup, flight cancelled. i cannot be primary tonight (22:00-06:00 PT). can someone pick up primary for that window? sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

Devon: can probably cover but i've got a deploy until ~00:30 PT. i can be primary from 01:00-06:00. anyone able to own 22:00-01:00?

Mira: i can take 22:00-02:00 and then hand over to Devon at 02:00 if that works. i have no other blockers. happy to be primary for the earlier chunk. :thumbsup:

Kai: i can do 22:00-00:30 as a hotshadow/secondary if Mira wants to be primary from 22:00. i can also stay on until 01:00 if needed.

Sam: quick runbook reminder — please walk through the handoff checklist and update the oncall roster after agreement. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff

Sam: runbook excerpt:
```
Handoff checklist:
- confirm new primary in PagerDuty: `/pd set-primary <user>`
- post coverage update to #eng-oncall with timeframe
- share open incident tickets (PD/ops list) + any watchlist traces
- ensure telemetry dashboard has alert links pinned
```

IncidentBot: PagerDuty notice: please run `/pd show-oncall primary` after you set the new primary so the escalation policy is validated.

Mira: @IncidentBot done, i'm set as primary in my local PD view. devon — is 02:00 handover okay for you?

Devon: 02:00 is fine. i'll be available on phone if anything spikes during deploy window. i'll take over at 02:00 PT.

Kai: i'll remain secondary until 01:00 then drop to standby. will watch latency dashboards 22:30-00:30 for the usual embed surges.

Sam: small note on customer impact — there's a scheduled batch job at 23:15 that sometimes spikes memory on dedicated pools. if it fires tonight, prioritize capacity-shed runbook step 3: `kill-batch-orchestration` (see runbook).

Alex: thank you all — huge help. i'll update the calendar and rotation doc now. alex: i posted a quick note in product-support about temporary primary swap so CS knows who to escalate to.

Devon: if anyone wants me to rename the oncall Slack alias temporarily, say so. otherwise i'll let Mira own the channel during her primary window. :ok_hand:

Mira: i'll post a short pinned message in #eng-oncall with the handoff summary + links, and leave a bullet list in the rotation doc.

PagerDuty: Alert: new primary assigned — Mira (22:00-02:00), Devon (02:00-06:00). Notifications routed to mobile + SMS for both.

Alex: awesome, closing this thread. thanks everyone. :heart:
